purpose: On licensed fresh HOLDOUT text, causally split the L11H3 subject current-value branch by the exact upstream write families that form its pre-attention state: embedding/skip, earlier attention writes, and earlier MLP writes.

licensed_precondition.rows: Licensed HOLDOUT only; FIT remains forbidden.

motivating_result.finding: The registered current-state value branch carried the task on licensed HOLDOUT, while the cached branch and interaction-needed accounts were null and the number-specific alternative held. This receipt uses only that registered terminal summary to choose the upstream split.

prior_art_audit.finding: Canonical v13 explicitly leaves a finer causal split within the current-state value branch as next_missing. No Task14 event uses an E/A/M factorial at this site.

Prior code decomposed an MLP10 input into propagated upstream writes for a different module and objective. It supports the residual bookkeeping, but did not intervene on Task14 L11H3, its subject source, or its current-value branch.
The earlier Task14 factorial grouped source positions after the value projection. It explicitly did not identify the upstream writers that created a source value.

exact_state_decomposition.recursion: Start E=x0, A=0, M=0. At each block i entry set E=lambda0_i E + lambda1_i x0, A=lambda0_i A, M=lambda0_i M. After attention i add its write to A; after MLP i add its write to M.
exact_state_decomposition.capture_point: Immediately after the block-11 entry recurrence and before RMSNorm/attention11. Thus E includes normalized embedding plus every propagated x0 injection, A includes propagated attention writes 0--10, and M includes propagated MLP writes 0--10.
exact_state_decomposition.identity: E+A+M equals the raw pre-attention-11 residual; RMSNorm(E+A+M) equals the native attention11 input up to the registered tolerance.
exact_state_decomposition.current_value: For each E/A/M corner, RMSNorm the combined state, apply block11 c_v, select head 3, multiply by (1-lambda_11), add the fixed recipient cached branch in 128-dimensional head-value coordinates, and apply the head-3 c_proj slice once.
exact_state_decomposition.installed_head: Multiply that subject value by fixed recipient p_8, add the recipient sum over j != 8 of p_j u_j, and install the resulting L11H3 write at the final query.

conditions.recipient_EAM: recipient E, recipient A, recipient M; same-batch no-op
conditions.opposite_EAM: opposite E, A, and M; must reproduce the previously registered opposite-current intervention
conditions.lexical_EAM: same-number different-lemma E, A, and M

estimands.pair_interactions: I_EA=Y(110)-Y(100)-Y(010)+Y(000), with analogous E/M and A/M definitions.
estimands.total_interaction: Y(111)-Y(100)-Y(010)-Y(001)+2Y(000), equal to the sum of all pair and triple interaction terms.
estimands.lexical_controls: Repeat each singleton and all-donor contrast using the same-number different-lemma endpoint.

outcomes.answer_directed_target_margin_improvemen: For opposite-number arms, patched opposite-answer-minus-recipient-answer margin minus native. For lexical arms, patched correct-answer-minus-foil margin minus native. Positive is helpful for the named target.
outcomes.target_full_vocab_CE_improvement: Native target-answer full-vocabulary CE minus patched target-answer CE at the identical batch index. Positive is helpful.
outcomes.restriction: No activation norm, variance, reconstruction, rank, or fitted score is an outcome.

opposing_predictions.embedding_carries_task: In every direction/template cell, the E singleton improves target margin and CE on at least 3/4 rows and recovers at least 70% of the all-opposite EAM margin effect.
opposing_predictions.attention_carries_task: The same criterion holds for the A singleton.
opposing_predictions.MLP_carries_task: The same criterion holds for the M singleton.
opposing_predictions.distributed_across_writer_families: In every cell no singleton reaches 70%, but at least two singleton families each recover at least 25% and improve both margin and CE on at least 3/4 rows.
opposing_predictions.interaction_is_needed: In every cell no singleton recovers more than 50%, while total E/A/M interaction recovers at least 50% of the all-opposite margin effect and is positive in both margin and CE on at least 3/4 rows.
opposing_predictions.number_specific: Every same-number lexical singleton/all-donor absolute mean margin and CE effect is at most 25% of the corresponding all-opposite effect.
opposing_predictions.lexical_collateral: If any lexical singleton/all-donor absolute mean margin or CE effect reaches 50% of the corresponding all-opposite effect, the clean number-specific interpretation is invalidated. Intermediate ratios remain unresolved.

instrument_gate: Exact native replay, E+A+M closure before and after RMSNorm, source-term summation, all-donor reproduction of the registered current-branch intervention, same-batch no-op, installed-head algebra, and a live all-opposite task effect must pass before any writer-family prediction is interpreted.
terminal_policy: Keep every opposing prediction separate. Do not drop rows, pool templates, tune thresholds, reinterpret a fixed-margin sign, or use any non-task metric after outcomes.
closed_claims: individual attention or MLP block identity
syntax generality beyond the licensed templates
